rows.ja: ロイヤルティ源(製品を販売する製薬会社)
出資・買収・権利取得

relations.text: COPD薬オーツベイアの売上の3%のロイヤルティを受け取る
relations.text_en: Earns a 3% royalty on Merck's COPD drug Ohtuvayre

source.label: Ligand 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We acquired a royalty on Merck's Ohtuvayre (ensifentrine) through our acquisition of Vernalis in 2018

relations.text: 1型糖尿病薬Tzieldの売上に1%未満のロイヤルティ
relations.text_en: Earns a sub-1% royalty on Sanofi's Tzield

source.label: Ligand 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Tzield/Teizeild (Sanofi) We acquired a royalty of less than 1% on net sales of Tzield through our acquisition of Tolerance Therapeutics ("Tolerance") in the fourth quarter of 2023.

relations.text: 外用薬Qtorinラパマイシンの経済的権利を保有
relations.text_en: Holds economic rights to its topical Qtorin rapamycin

source.label: Ligand 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We acquired economic rights to QtorinTM 3.9% rapamycin anhydrous gel (Qtorin rapamycin, formerly PTX-022) from Palvella in December 2018.

companies.name: アルボジェン/アダルボ

relations.text: テリパラチド注射剤の権利(ペフェネクス買収で取得)
relations.text_en: Rights to its teriparatide injection product, from the Pfenex deal

source.label: Ligand 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Teriparatide Injection Product (PF708) (Alvogen/Adalvo) We acquired rights to the teriparatide injection product with the acquisition of Pfenex in October 2020.

relations.text: リガンド(旧ヴェルナリス)からオーツベイアの元となる権利を導入
relations.text_en: Licensed the rights behind Ohtuvayre from Ligand (formerly Vernalis)

source.label: Verona Pharma 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: License agreement with Ligand (formerly Vernalis) In February 2005, Rhinopharma Limited ("Rhinopharma") entered into an assignment and license agreement

companies.name: オーケストラ・バイオメド

relations.text: 後期の循環器プログラムに2,500万ドルを出資
relations.text_en: Invested $25 million in its late-stage cardiology programs

source.label: Ligand 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we invested $25 million in strategic capital to fund Orchestra BioMed Holdings, Inc.'s ("Orchestra" or "Orchestra Biomed") late-stage partnered cardiology programs

relations.text: がん免疫薬Bot/Balの売上に対する合成ロイヤルティを取得(2025年に全額減損)
relations.text_en: Bought a synthetic royalty on Bot/Bal; fully impaired in 2025

source.label: Ligand 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we acquired a synthetic royalty on future global net sales of Agenus' novel immuno-oncology botensilimab in combination with balstilimab ("Bot/Bal") program

relations.text: 神経芽腫薬Qarzibaのロイヤルティを持つ同社を2024年に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired in 2024 with royalty rights to Qarziba

source.label: Ligand 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On July 15, 2024, we acquired all the outstanding shares of Biologics AG ("Apeiron"), including the royalty rights to Qarziba (dinutuximab beta) for the treatment of high-risk neuroblastoma

relations.text: 2025年9月に700万ドルで経済的権利を取得
relations.text_en: Bought economic rights for $7 million in September 2025

source.label: Ligand 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On September 24, 2025, we invested $ 7 million to purchase economic rights from Arecor Limited ("Arecor")

source.quote: attributable to the fair value changes of the shares of Pelthos common stock and Pelthos Series A convertible preferred stock
